artifacts.summary: Nine-phase plan promoting the Lean appendix's file-local code-presentation rules to one book-wide Typst environment with two declared kinds, migrating all 50 code blocks, adding a Check 4 to the tracked drift detector, and documenting the budget and fidelity policy.

memory_candidates.content: When planning a mechanical enforcement check for this repository, the target script must be git-tracked. The typst element lint and chapter-quality check live under .claude/scripts/, which is gitignored and regenerated from an external source store, so an edit there is silently wiped by the next deploy and violates the source-store/deploy boundary rule. scripts/typst-sync-check.sh is the tracked, extensible enforcement surface for anything about typst/, and its Check 1 already carries reusable machinery for resolving an identifier against live non-Boneyard Lean source across multiple source roots with a whitelist escape hatch. Prefer extending it with a new named check over touching any deployed lint.
